ef_source: Central Electricity Authority, CO2 Baseline Database v21.0 (FY2024-25): weighted average 0.710, CDM simple operating margin 0.961, build margin 0.512 and COMBINED MARGIN 0.736 tCO2/MWh (the CDM default is an equal-weight blend of the operating and build margins, and it is the convention's own factor for assessing a programme that adds new load), all at the generation busbar. The operating margin is the average of the non-must-run generation that responds to load and the build margin the intensity of recent capacity additions; mapping them onto the marginal and clean states is our interpretation, not the CEA's. India is the only country here with all three published; Ember's operational figure for India is 0.670, 6% below the CEA weighted average, so India's average sits on a different basis from the other three rows.
price_source: GlobalPetrolPrices international comparison of business electricity prices (the multi-year average series the source recommends for cross-country comparison). The India country page quotes 0.116 USD/kWh for June 2025, about 5% below the comparison-table value used here.
